entities.name: Protoheme IX farnesyltransferase 2
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt A0RZ28, a reviewed 310-residue multi-pass membrane enzyme.
Belongs to the UbiA prenyltransferase family; Pfam UbiA domain spans residues 24–291.
Annotated EC 2.5.1.141 and GO protoheme IX farnesyltransferase activity.

entities.name: Heme B farnesylation
observations: Catalyzes heme B + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + H2O → heme O + diphosphate.
The reaction substitutes the C2 vinyl group of protoheme IX with a hydroxyethyl farnesyl side chain.

entities.name: Heme O biosynthesis
observations: Protoheme IX farnesylation is the annotated first and final step converting heme B to heme O in the pathway.

entities.name: UbiA membrane topology
observations: The 310-residue sequence is strongly hydrophobic and annotated with approximately nine transmembrane helices, consistent with an integral membrane UbiA-family active site.
